purpose: Fail CI when the CAD/BIM toolchain adds a copyleft or source-available dependency that has not been explicitly reviewed.
release_blockers: Qualified legal counsel has not countersigned the existing Phase 18 open-source license audit.
The redistributable CAD toolchain packaging path must include the required LGPL/GPL license texts and any applicable source offer or source pointers.
Some transitive packages expose license files without a normalized SPDX identifier; these require package-specific review before a redistributable release.

approved_copyleft_components.rationale: Direct worker dependency. Its LGPL terms and corresponding notices must be satisfied for any redistribution.
Executed as a separate native process. Redistribution still requires the applicable licence materials and legal review.
Native geometry kernel recorded in the FreeCAD toolchain. The exact exception text and distribution model must be preserved.

review_rules: A newly discovered copyleft component must be added to this policy only after an explicit engineering review and recorded licence rationale.
LGPL is not treated as automatically prohibited; the exact version, exception, linking/process model, notices, and redistribution obligations must be assessed.
CI approval is not legal clearance. Commercial release remains blocked until commercial_release_approved is true and release blockers are resolved.
Unknown package licence metadata is a warning during ordinary CI only when an installed licence file is recorded; release mode treats warnings as blockers.
